name: Playwright with Python
intro: Hands-on guides to browser test automation with Playwright and Python: pytest fixtures, page objects, saved login state, flaky tests, reports and CI. Every code example is run before it is published.

name: API testing
intro: API testing for QA engineers: Playwright and Python Requests, Postman collections, JSON Schema validation, authentication and refresh tokens, and negative tests. Every code example is run before it is published.

name: QA fundamentals
intro: The core skills of software QA: writing bug reports that get fixed, deciding what to automate, exploratory testing, test design, traceability and release checks.

name: Testing multi-tenant SaaS
intro: How to test multi-tenant SaaS products: data isolation between tenants, roles and permissions, and tenant-specific configuration, with test matrices and runnable examples.

name: BDD with Behave
intro: Behavior-driven development in Python with Behave and Selenium: writing clear Gherkin, structuring the framework, hooks, page objects and reports.

name: Performance testing with JMeter
intro: Performance testing with Apache JMeter: load and spike tests, thread group settings, reading the results, and fixing common errors.

name: AI Lab
intro: Hands-on experiments with AI tools in QA work, always with human review: drafting test cases, reviewing AI-written tests, and where AI should not be trusted in testing.

name: QA careers
intro: Starting and growing a career in software QA, especially in Nepal and South Asia: skills, interviews, and moving from manual testing into automation.
